sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find red and green shapes only
red_shapes = []
green_shapes = []
yellow_markers = []

for n in seg['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
    r_max = max(p[0] for p in b)
    c_min = min(p[1] for p in b)
    c_max = max(p[1] for p in b)
    center = ((r_min + r_max) // 2, (c_min + c_max) // 2)
    
    if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] == 10:
        red_shapes.append({'id': n['id'], 'bbox': (r_min, c_min, r_max, c_max), 'center': center})
    elif n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 10:
        green_shapes.append({'id': n['id'], 'bbox': (r_min, c_min, r_max, c_max), 'center': center})
    elif n['color'] == 'Y':
        yellow_markers.append({'id': n['id'], 'pixels': n['pixels'], 'bbox': (r_min, c_min, r_max, c_max), 'center': center})

print("Red shapes:")
for r in red_shapes:
    print(f"  center={r['center']}, bbox={r['bbox']}")

print("\nGreen shapes:")
for g in green_shapes:
    print(f"  center={g['center']}, bbox={g['bbox']}")

print("\nYellow markers:")
for y in yellow_markers:
    print(f"  center={y['center']}, pixels={y['pixels']}, bbox={y['bbox']}")

# Test clicking on top red shape
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': red_shapes[0]['center'][0], 'col': red_shapes[0]['center'][1]}])
print(f"\nClicked top red at {red_shapes[0]['center']}")
print("Board changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
print("Gameplay changed:", last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
